title: Andaman Island Escape
alt: Forest meeting the white sand of Radhanagar Beach, Havelock Island
overview: A compact first taste of the Andamans: the Cellular Jail story, Elephant Beach and Radhanagar on Havelock, the beaches and rock bridge of Neil, and a Chidiyatapu sunset.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Port Blair · Cellular Jail, Corbyn’s Cove & Light and Sound Show
description: Arrive at Port Blair (Sri Vijaya Puram), the capital of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Our representative will meet you outside the airport and transfer you to your hotel.

After lunch, visit the Cellular Jail, which brings back the years of India’s freedom struggle, and Corbyn’s Cove, a coconut palm-fringed beach where you can relax or try water sports (at your own cost). In the evening, watch the Light & Sound Show at the Cellular Jail.
Overnight stay in Port Blair.

itinerary.title: Cruise to Havelock (Swaraj Dweep) · Elephant Beach & Radhanagar Beach
description: Collect a packed breakfast, check out and take the cruise to Havelock Island. Our representative will receive you and take you to Elephant Beach.

Elephant Beach is one of the most beautiful places on Havelock Island, famous for clear water, live corals and colourful fish. The reef begins only a metre or two from the shore. The beach is open in the first half of the day, so a morning visit gives you the most time there.
Water activities such as glass-bottom boat rides, snorkelling, banana rides and sofa rides are available (at your own cost).

After lunch, visit Radhanagar. Spend a few hours at Radhanagar Beach, known as one of the best beaches in Asia. Its turquoise water, white sand and calm surroundings make it perfect for relaxing, and the sunset views here become some of the best memories of an Andaman trip.
Overnight stay in Havelock.

itinerary.title: Cruise to Neil (Shaheed Dweep) · Laxmanpur, Natural Bridge & Bharatpur
description: After breakfast, take the cruise to Neil Island. Our representative will take you to your hotel, then out to the island’s best-known spots.
Laxmanpur Beach is a wide, white-sand beach full of shells, ideal for an evening walk.
The Natural Bridge (also called Howrah Bridge) is a rock formation reached by walking along the rocky shore, with the open sea on one side and green forest on the other.

Bharatpur Beach is perfect for swimming and lazing around, with a living coral reef close to shore. Snorkelling and scuba diving are available here, and a glass-bottom boat ride shows the marine life to those who prefer to stay dry.
Overnight stay on Neil Island.

itinerary.title: Return to Port Blair · Chidiyatapu sunset
description: After breakfast, take the cruise back to Port Blair and check in.
After lunch, drive 28 km to Chidiyatapu, the southern tip of South Andaman. Known as Andaman’s bird island, it has mangrove forest, many bird species and wide sunset views over the ocean.
Overnight stay in Port Blair.

itinerary.title: Departure from Port Blair
description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Port Blair airport for your onward flight. Your trip ends with sweet memories.

title: North to South Andaman
overview: The complete Andaman road and sea journey: Havelock and Neil, then north through Baratang to Mayabunder, Diglipur’s Ross & Smith twin islands and the beaches of Rangat.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Port Blair · Cellular Jail, Corbyn’s Cove & Light and Sound Show
description: Our driver will meet you at the airport and transfer you to your hotel.
After lunch, visit the Cellular Jail and Corbyn’s Cove Beach. In the evening, watch the Light & Sound Show at the Cellular Jail.
Overnight stay in Port Blair.

itinerary.title: Cruise to Havelock · Radhanagar Beach
description: After check-out, our driver drops you at the cruise terminal. At Havelock jetty our tour coordinator meets you and takes you to the resort.

Around 2 pm, head to Radhanagar Beach. Spend a few hours at Radhanagar Beach, known as one of the best beaches in Asia. Its turquoise water, white sand and calm surroundings make it perfect for relaxing, and the sunset views here become some of the best memories of an Andaman trip.
Dinner and overnight stay in Havelock.

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach by speed boat · Kalapathar Beach
description: Around 9 am, take a speed boat from the jetty to Elephant Beach.

Elephant Beach is one of the most beautiful places on Havelock Island, famous for clear water, live corals and colourful fish. The reef begins only a metre or two from the shore. The beach is open in the first half of the day, so a morning visit gives you the most time there.

After lunch, visit Kalapathar Beach. Kalapathar Beach sits on one corner of Havelock Island and takes its name from the village and the black rocks (kala pathar) along its shore. It is a peaceful place with lush forest behind the sand and a beautiful sunset.
Overnight stay in Havelock.

itinerary.title: Cruise to Neil · Laxmanpur, Natural Bridge & Bharatpur
description: After breakfast and check-out, take the cruise at around 8:30 am and reach Neil Island by about 10:30 am.
After freshening up, visit Laxmanpur Beach, the Natural Bridge and Bharatpur Beach.
Overnight stay on Neil Island.

itinerary.title: Return to Port Blair · Samudrika & Anthropological Museums
description: After breakfast, take the cruise back to Port Blair and check in.
Around 2 pm, visit the Samudrika Naval Marine Museum and the Anthropological Museum.
Overnight stay in Port Blair.

itinerary.title: North via Baratang to Mayabunder
description: Leave around 4 am with a packed breakfast to join the first convoy from Jirkatang at 6 am.

Baratang Island is around 100 km from Port Blair through tribal reserve forest. Vehicles pass the Jarawa reserve in a convoy, and the first convoy leaves the Jirkatang check post at 6 am, so we start early to allow enough time for the caves. A boat ride through mangrove creeks leads to the limestone caves, and a short jeep ride takes you to the mud volcano.
Continue north to Mayabunder and check in around 5:30 pm. Overnight stay in Mayabunder.

itinerary.title: Mayabunder to Diglipur · Ross & Smith twin islands
description: Check out early and drive about 80 km north to Diglipur, a rare destination for eco-friendly travellers.
Visit Ross and Smith Islands, the twin islands joined by a narrow bar of dazzling white sand.
Check in around 4 pm. Overnight stay in Diglipur.

itinerary.title: Diglipur to Rangat · Amkunj, Cuthbert Bay & Morrice Dera
description: Check out around 6 am for the drive of about 100–110 km (four hours or more) to Rangat.
Between 1 pm and 4 pm, visit Amkunj Beach, Cuthbert Bay Beach and Morrice Dera Beach.
Check in around 5:30 pm. Overnight stay in Rangat.

itinerary.title: Rangat to Port Blair through the heartland
description: Leave early for the 170 km drive back to Port Blair. More than a transfer, it is a journey through the heart of the Andamans, with panoramic views and hidden gems along the way.
Check in around 4:30 pm. Overnight stay in Port Blair.

itinerary.title: Ross Island & North Bay Coral Island
description: After breakfast, our driver drops you at the jetty. Take a boat to Ross Island (Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Island), where the ruins of a water distillation plant, swimming pool, Japanese bunkers, church and bakery show how the British settlement once lived.

Continue by ferry to North Bay Coral Island, famous for water activities such as jet ski rides, scuba diving, the semi-submarine coral safari, sea walking, the Andaman Dolphin ride and parasailing (at your own cost).
